name: Entity Type
description: This list of built-in entity types plus other entity types that may be added
purposes: Define the schema, category, and state model for each kind of entity ETM manages
Register new entity types as the taxonomy grows

name: Taxonomy
description: Formal entity definitions and hierarchies
purposes: Classify entities into consistent types and hierarchies
Give agents and people a shared vocabulary

name: Taxonomy Map
description: Mapping of entities across different taxonomies
purposes: Define entity synonyms across different taxonomies
Define similarities and differences across entities that are partially synonymous.

name: Ontology
description: Formal concept hierarchies and relationship definitions
purposes: Define how concepts relate to one another
Support agent reasoning across connected entities

name: Ontology Map
description: Mapping of entities and relationships across different ontologies
purposes: Align concepts and relationships across different ontologies
Translate between domain or client models without losing meaning

name: Data Mapping
description: Mapping of abstract entities into physical data schemas
purposes: Map abstract entity types to database tables and fields
Generate and validate physical schemas

name: Causal Model
description: Cause-and-effect relationships among factors in a system
purposes: Explain why outcomes occur
Assess the likely effects of proposed changes

name: State Model
description: Lifecycle states and allowed transitions for an entity type
purposes: Define valid states, transitions, and preconditions
Enforce lifecycle rules when entities change

name: Predictive Model
description: A model that forecasts future values or outcomes from data
purposes: Forecast outcomes, risks, and trends
Inform decisions before results are known

name: Person
description: A human person
purposes: Identify individuals across all roles and organizations
Anchor person role sub-types such as Employee and Accountable Owner

name: Organization
description: Any structured collection of people
purposes: Represent any group of people as a single entity
Serve as parent type for companies, units, and teams

name: Account
description: Customer organization
purposes: Track a customer relationship as a commercial record
Link contacts, opportunities, and engagements to a customer

name: Company
description: A legally constituted business organization
purposes: Represent legal business entities
Serve as parent type for Vendor and Partner

name: Subsidiary
description: A company owned or controlled by a parent company
purposes: Model ownership and control between companies
Roll up subsidiary results to the parent

name: Division
description: A major business unit within a company
purposes: Group departments under a business unit
Assign division-level goals, ownership, and results

name: Department
description: A functional unit within a company or division
purposes: Organize people by function
Assign functional accountability and processes

name: Team
description: A small group of people doing shared work
purposes: Assign work, goals, and ownership to working groups
Track team-level execution

name: Organization Structure
description: Ontological mapping of organizational entities
purposes: Model reporting and containment relationships among organizational entities
Show which units contain which and who reports to whom

name: Vendor
description: A company that supplies goods or services to the organization
purposes: Track supplier relationships, contracts, and dependencies
Assess vendor risk and performance

name: Partner
description: A company that works with the organization for mutual benefit
purposes: Track alliance, channel, and delivery partnerships
Coordinate shared work and commitments

name: Employee
description: A person employed directly by the organization
purposes: Track staff, roles, and reporting lines
Assign internal ownership and work

name: Contractor
description: A person engaged under contract to perform defined work
purposes: Track non-employee workers and contract terms
Assign defined work and access

name: Consultant
description: An external person engaged to provide expert advice
purposes: Track advisory engagements and their scope
Distinguish advice from delivered work

name: Board Member
description: A person serving on a governing or advisory board
purposes: Track governance roles and oversight
Route board-level decisions and escalations

name: Hiring Manager
description: A person responsible for filling an open role
purposes: Assign ownership of open roles and hiring decisions
Route candidate reviews and approvals

name: Supervisor
description: A person who directs and oversees the work of others
purposes: Define reporting lines
Route approvals, reviews, and escalations to the right person

name: Process
description: A defined sequence of steps that produces an output
purposes: Describe how work gets done
Serve as parent type for all process variants

name: Abstract Process
description: A general process pattern not tied to a specific implementation
purposes: Capture reusable process designs
Instantiate concrete processes from a common pattern

name: Meta-Process
description: A process whose intended output is a process
purposes: Generate, design, or improve other processes
Automate process creation within ETM

name: Persistent Process
description: A long-running process that can pause in wait states for human-in-the-loop (HITL) input or other external events
purposes: Run work that spans long periods
Pause for HITL decisions or external events and resume with state intact

name: BPMN Process
description: A persistent process defined in BPMN notation
purposes: Model processes in a standard, tool-readable format
Execute or exchange processes with BPMN engines

name: Checklist
description: An ordered list of items to verify or complete
purposes: Verify that required steps or criteria are met
Enforce quality gates before state transitions

name: Injectable Context
description: Content that can be inserted into an agent's working context
purposes: Supply agents with the knowledge a task needs
Serve as parent type for axioms, heuristics, templates, guidance, and skills

name: Axioms
description: A statement taken as true without further justification
purposes: Set fixed premises for agent reasoning
Keep agents consistent with non-negotiable facts and rules

name: Heuristics
description: A rule of thumb that guides judgment under uncertainty
purposes: Help agents make reasonable choices without full information
Capture practical experience as reusable guidance

name: Prompt Template
description: A reusable prompt structure with placeholders for inputs
purposes: Standardize how agents are instructed
Produce consistent prompts across tasks

name: Agent Guidance
description: Instructions on how an agent should behave or approach a task
purposes: Shape agent behavior, scope, and boundaries
Direct agents on when and how to act

name: Mental Models
description: Structured collection of ontologies, taxonomies, causal models, state models, axioms, heuristics, prompt templates, and reasoning guidance.
purposes: Bundle related reasoning components into one coherent frame
Give agents a consistent way to understand and decide within a domain

name: Thought Processes
description: Flowchart of reasoning steps
purposes: Guide agents through multi-step reasoning
Make reasoning repeatable and reviewable

name: Skill
description: A package of injectable context
purposes: Package capabilities and procedures that agents can load
Reuse proven context across agents and tasks

name: Lazy-Load Skill
description: A skill + guidance on when the skill should be loaded
purposes: Load skills only when they are needed
Keep agent context small and focused

name: Decision
description: A recorded choice with its context and rationale
purposes: Capture what was decided, why, and by whom
Provide traceability for later review

name: ADR
description: Architecture Decision Record
purposes: Record architectural decisions with context, rationale, and consequences
Avoid reopening settled design questions

name: Accountable Owner
description: The single person answerable for a goal, outcome, or process
purposes: Assign clear ownership for results
Route decisions, approvals, and escalations to one person

name: Goals
description: A desired result the organization intends to achieve
purposes: Set direction for programs, projects, and machines
Measure progress against intended results

name: SMART Project Goals
description: A specific, measurable, time-bound goal for a project
purposes: Define clear, testable project targets
Determine when a project has succeeded

name: Operational Goals
description: An ongoing goal for running and sustaining operations
purposes: Set targets for steady-state performance
Track ongoing operational health

name: Execution Process
description: A structured effort to carry out work toward goals
purposes: Organize work that delivers goals and outcomes
Serve as parent type for programs and projects

name: Programs
description: A coordinated group of related projects with a shared objective
purposes: Coordinate dependencies, resources, and benefits across projects
Govern multi-project initiatives

name: Projects
description: A time-bound effort with defined scope and deliverables
purposes: Plan and track scoped work to completion
Tie deliverables and milestones to SMART goals

name: Outcome
description: A result or change produced by execution
purposes: Record what execution actually achieved
Compare actual results to goals

name: Deliverable
description: A concrete output produced by a project
purposes: Define what a project must produce
Track acceptance and completion of outputs

name: Progress Indicator
description: Any measure or checkpoint used to track progress toward goals and outcomes
purposes: Show whether execution is on track
Trigger attention or escalation when progress stalls

name: Milestone
description: A key checkpoint or deadline in execution
purposes: Mark significant points in a schedule
Confirm required progress has been reached by a date

name: Policies
description: A mandatory rule that governs decisions and actions
purposes: Constrain entity creation, state transitions, and agent actions
Provide the basis for controls and compliance checks

name: Practices
description: A recommended way of working, followed by convention
purposes: Share proven ways of doing work
Guide behavior where no mandatory rule applies

name: Escalations
description: A request to raise an issue to a higher authority
purposes: Route blocked or out-of-bounds issues to the right owner
Track escalated issues to resolution

name: Metrics
description: A defined quantitative measure with a calculation and unit
purposes: Measure performance against goals
Provide data for progress indicators and decisions

name: Machine
description: Collection of Goals, Outcomes, Accountable Owner, People, Process, and Technology
purposes: Model a complete capability unit from goals through technology
Govern and improve how that unit delivers outcomes

name: Strategy
description: A chosen approach for achieving one or more goals
purposes: Link goals to the plans and programs that pursue them
Detect execution that serves no stated strategy

name: Plan
description: A time-bound arrangement of work, resources and milestones that carries out a strategy
purposes: Turn strategy into scheduled, resourced work
Compare actual execution with the agreed plan

name: Roadmap
description: A sequenced plan of capabilities or releases over time
purposes: Communicate what will be delivered and when
Link customer commitments to planned dates

name: Mission
description: The organization's enduring purpose
purposes: Give people and agents a common reason for their work
Test goals and strategies for fit

name: Vision
description: The future state the organization intends to reach
purposes: Set long-range direction for strategies
Frame multi-year goals

name: Principle
description: A fundamental belief that guides choices where no rule applies
purposes: Guide judgment by people and agents
Serve as parent type for cultural and ethical principles

name: Cultural Principle
description: A value or norm describing how people in the organization work together
purposes: Keep agent behavior consistent with company culture
Make values explicit and testable

name: Ethical Principle
description: A standard of right conduct the organization commits to
purposes: Bound what agents and people do even where policy permits it
Support ethics reviews of agent actions

name: Objective (OKR)
description: A qualitative goal paired with measurable key results
purposes: Support OKR-based planning
Link periodic objectives to strategy

name: Key Result
description: A measurable result showing progress toward an objective
purposes: Measure objective achievement
Trigger attention when key results lag

name: KPI
description: A metric designated as a key indicator of performance
purposes: Focus attention on the few measures that matter
Feed dashboards and escalation thresholds

name: Target
description: A desired value of a metric by a date
purposes: Make goals and KPIs testable
Detect gaps between actual and intended values

name: Commitment
description: A promise by an owner to deliver something by a date, to a customer or internally
purposes: Track promises across handoffs
Flag commitments put at risk by plan changes

name: Assumption
description: A belief that a plan or decision depends on and that has not been verified
purposes: Make planning premises explicit
Re-test plans when an assumption is disproved

name: Risk
description: A possible future event that would affect goals, with likelihood and impact
purposes: Anticipate threats to goals
Assign owners and mitigations

name: Issue
description: A current problem affecting execution that needs resolution
purposes: Track blockers to resolution
Provide the source for escalations

name: Dependency
description: A condition where one piece of work or outcome requires another
purposes: Expose critical paths across teams and programs
Warn downstream owners when upstream work changes

name: Constraint
description: A limit on options, such as budget, time, capacity or technical boundaries
purposes: Bound plans and agent choices
Explain why options were excluded

name: Budget
description: A financial or resource allocation to a goal, program, project or unit
purposes: Tie resources to priorities
Detect work without funding, or funding without goals

name: Requirement
description: A capability or condition that a deliverable must satisfy
purposes: Link goals to what deliverables must do
Verify deliverables before acceptance

name: Role
description: A named set of responsibilities and authority that a person or agent can hold
purposes: Separate what a position does from who holds it
Give agents bounded authority

name: Role Assignment
description: A person or agent holding a role for a scope and period, such as a RACI assignment
purposes: Record who is responsible, accountable, consulted and informed
Keep accountability current as people change

name: Decision Right
description: Authority to make or approve a class of decisions, up to stated limits
purposes: Route decisions to whoever is authorized
Enforce limits such as discount authority

name: Approval
description: A decision authorizing an action, change or state transition
purposes: Record who authorized what under which decision right
Gate state transitions

name: Policy Exception
description: An approved, time-limited departure from a policy
purposes: Allow justified exceptions without changing the policy
Expire and review exceptions

name: Control
description: A mechanism that enforces or verifies compliance with a policy
purposes: Link policies to how they are enforced
Support audits and compliance checks

name: Obligation
description: An external requirement from law, regulation, standard or contract
purposes: Trace policies to their legal or contractual source
Show impact when requirements change

name: Alignment Finding
description: A detected inconsistency between an action, plan or decision and the goals, policies or principles it should serve
purposes: Surface misalignment to the accountable owner
Track it to resolution

name: Review
description: A scheduled assessment of progress, outcomes or alignment, such as a quarterly business review or retrospective
purposes: Create regular checkpoints for realignment
Produce decisions, lessons and actions

name: Action Item
description: A specific task assigned to an owner with a due date
purposes: Track follow-through from meetings, reviews and escalations
Close the loop on decisions

name: Lesson Learned
description: An insight gained from experience, with the context in which it applies
purposes: Avoid repeating mistakes
Spread what worked across people and agents

name: Fact
description: A statement believed true for a stated period, with its source and confidence
purposes: Hold atomic, verifiable knowledge
Support conflict and staleness checks

name: Preference
description: A stated choice or liking of a person, team or customer
purposes: Personalize agent behavior
Respect stakeholder choices

name: Handoff
description: A transfer of work and context from one owner, stage or agent to another
purposes: Prevent loss of context between stages
Flag missing items at each boundary

name: Open Question
description: A known unknown that someone needs answered
purposes: Make knowledge gaps explicit
Route questions to people who can answer them

name: Episode
description: A recorded interaction or session, such as an agent transcript or meeting record
purposes: Serve as evidence for extracted knowledge
Trace knowledge back to its source

name: Document
description: A unit of authored content, such as a report, policy document or presentation
purposes: Store or reference source material
Cite where knowledge came from

name: External Reference
description: A pointer to an object held in an authoritative external system, with a cached snapshot and freshness rule
purposes: Reference systems of record instead of copying them
Keep knowledge in step with the source

name: Glossary Term
description: A word, phrase or acronym with its definition in the organization's language
purposes: Give agents the company vocabulary
Resolve ambiguous names and acronyms

name: Time Period
description: A named period, such as a fiscal quarter or planning cycle
purposes: Align goals, budgets and metrics on shared calendars
Compare results period over period

name: Event
description: Something that happened at a point in time relevant to the organization
purposes: Anchor causes, outcomes and timelines
Trigger processes and reviews

name: Meeting
description: A gathering of people, and possibly agents, that produces decisions and actions
purposes: Capture decisions and action items at their source
Link attendees to outcomes

name: Location
description: A physical place or legal jurisdiction
purposes: Apply jurisdiction-specific obligations
Support data residency and office-level reporting

name: Contact
description: A person at an external organization the company deals with
purposes: Link people to accounts, partners and vendors
Track stakeholder roles in deals

name: System
description: A software application, platform or service the organization uses
purposes: Represent the Technology part of a Machine
Track which systems support which processes

name: Dataset
description: A defined collection of data with an owner and schema
purposes: Identify the data behind metrics and models
Track data ownership and lineage

name: AI Agent
description: An AI system that acts for a person or organization, defined by instructions, tools and a model
purposes: Treat agents as accountable actors distinct from people
Assign sponsors, roles and entitlements to agents

name: Agentic Workflow
description: A process carried out wholly or partly by AI agents
purposes: Describe multi-agent work as a reusable unit
Migrate workflows across systems

name: Agent Harness
description: A runtime that hosts and runs agents, such as a coding assistant or agent framework
purposes: Track where agents run
Choose delivery profiles and plan migrations

name: AI Model
description: A specific AI model and version used by agents
purposes: Record which model produced which output
Re-evaluate when models change

name: Agent Tool
description: A capability an agent can call, such as an MCP server or API
purposes: Govern which tools agents may use
Trace actions to the tools that performed them

name: Product
description: A product or service the organization offers
purposes: Anchor positioning, pricing, roadmap and support knowledge
Link customers to what they bought

name: Contract
description: A legally binding agreement with a customer, vendor, partner or employee
purposes: Hold terms, obligations and commitments
Trigger renewals and compliance checks

name: Test Suite
description: A versioned set of test cases for an agent, workflow or system
purposes: Group the tests that define acceptable behavior
Run regressions on every change

name: Test Case
description: An input with expected behavior and grading criteria
purposes: Define one checkable expectation
Detect regressions precisely

name: Competency Question
description: A question the knowledge base must be able to answer, with its expected answer
purposes: Measure knowledge coverage
Detect gaps and retrieval regressions

name: Evaluation Run
description: One execution of a test suite against a specific system version, with results
purposes: Compare versions on evidence
Record when a change broke something

name: Factor
description: A variable in a causal or predictive model
purposes: Name the drivers a model reasons about
Link model variables to metrics and data

name: Hypothesis
description: A testable proposed explanation of an outcome
purposes: Make explanations explicit before testing
Track which explanations held

name: Experiment
description: A controlled test of a hypothesis
purposes: Test changes before rolling them out
Record evidence for causal models

name: Bottleneck
description: A constraint on throughput or results identified by analysis
purposes: Show where value is held back
Prioritize improvements

name: Recommendation
description: A proposed course of action with its reasoning, options considered and confidence
purposes: Present decisions with visible reasoning
Track whether recommendations were followed and how they turned out

name: Option
description: An alternative considered for a decision
purposes: Record what was weighed, not only what was chosen
Avoid reopening rejected options

name: Decision Criterion
description: A factor used to compare options, with its weight
purposes: Make trade-offs explicit and repeatable
Align decisions with goals and principles

name: Offering
description: A packaged, priced configuration of products and services
purposes: Model packages and bundles
Link price points to what customers buy

name: Market Segment
description: A group of potential customers with shared characteristics
purposes: Target marketing and sales
Define ideal customer profiles per segment

name: Buyer Persona
description: A representative profile of a buyer or user role
purposes: Tailor messaging and product decisions to real roles

name: Competitor
description: A company competing for the same customers
purposes: Hold competitive positioning and win/loss knowledge

name: Positioning Statement
description: The approved statement of how an offering is differentiated for a segment
purposes: Keep generated content on message
Govern competitive claims

name: Campaign
description: A coordinated marketing effort with a goal and channels
purposes: Link leads to their sources
Capture campaign lessons

name: Lead
description: A person or organization that has shown interest but is not yet qualified
purposes: Track lead generation and qualification

name: Opportunity
description: A potential sale to an account, with stage and value
purposes: Track pipeline execution
Link deal commitments to accounts

name: Support Case
description: A customer request or problem handled by support
purposes: Link problems to fixes and known issues
Feed product and positioning feedback

name: Code Repository
description: A version-controlled store of source code
purposes: Anchor engineering knowledge to code
Provide supersession evidence from history

name: Software Component
description: A deployable service, module or library
purposes: Attach constraints, decisions and owners to the code they govern

name: Release
description: A versioned delivery of software
purposes: Link roadmap items, fixes and customer commitments to what shipped

name: Incident
description: An unplanned disruption to a service
purposes: Capture causes, fixes and lessons
Feed causal analysis
